about_the_game:
This free demo contains some introductory content from the full version . more relic and hero card will still update


Dual Management, Strategy Reigns Supreme

Guild Economy System

Become not just a battle commander, but a shrewd financial steward! Balance hero salaries, equipment purchases, and dynamic decisions like tax policies and adventurer benefits to ensure your team’s survival and growth amid monster invasions. Every coin you invest yields returns—adventurers will use spare funds to train, upgrade gear, and sharpen their skills!

Class Synergies & Relic Combos

Unlock powerful united strength effects by strategically pairing heroes of different classes. Combine these with mystical relics to forge an adventurer army unlike any other.

Dynamic Policies, Adapt to Survive

Policy Crafting

Respond to your guild’s evolving challenges with tailored policies. Shift strategies between crisis management and rapid growth—cut taxes to retain talent during a recession, or slash benefits to fund emergency defenses against a demonic siege. Survive bankruptcy today to thrive tomorrow!

Roguelike Adventures

Quests & Random Events

Dispatch teams on randomly generated quests, face unpredictable events, and encounter diverse heroes to recruit. Every choice reshapes your path to victory.

A Unique DBG Twist

Sacrifice isn’t always defeat. Will you nurture your veterans into legends, or embrace attrition as a strategy? Sometimes, fallen heroes leave rare relics… and bold heroes emerge when rewards are high.
